color.note: Six themes, chosen on 2026-11-06 from the proposals in Palettes. Slate is the default; Graphite and Umber are the other darks; Chalk, Mist and Paper are the lights, Mist being Slate's partner. Hue is reserved for meaning (ruling 11): status owns green, amber and red, the accent is the one action hue, and emphasis is weight and luminance.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground behind every pane. Nothing else is this color.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: A pane's body. Panes sit on bg, bordered by line, radius-md.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: A pane's header strip, a table head, an input's field, a socket on the agent's edge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Pane and control borders, the masthead rule, the stage rail's track, the agent's edge at rest.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row rules inside a table or a stream; never a pane border.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Text and identifiers on bg, panel and inset. At least 14.5:1 on bg in every theme.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: a pane's source line, a lede, a table head, a replayed trace row. At least 5.6:1 on bg and 5.2:1 on inset in every theme.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Notes under a control and the who-pill in the masthead, at label size. At least 3.2:1 on bg in every theme, above 3:1 and below 4.5:1, so a fact a person must act on is never set in faint; it is set in dim.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action hue: the current stage's underline, the focus ring, a primary button's border, a link under the pointer, the network field on a connector node. At least 4.6:1 as text on bg and 5.0:1 as a ring on panel in every theme, so it may carry text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: A tint under accent-bordered things: the availability banner, a query chip, a connector node's network field. Text on it is fg.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status green, always beside its word: connected, live, loaded, answered, acknowledged. At least 5.3:1 on panel in every theme. Never the only carrier of the fact.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Status amber, always beside its word: in transition, waiting on a verb, a decision standing, replayed. At least 6.0:1 on panel in every theme.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Status red, always beside its word: not connected, revoked, retired, failed, lost contact, a wire that does not attach. At least 6.0:1 on panel in every theme. Green and red are told apart by their words, not by hue alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on every control: 2px solid, offset 2px, on panel and inset. Alias of accent.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A page's one h1 and a pane's title when the pane is the page.

styles.name: pane-title
styles.usage: A pane header's title, beside its stage mark and backing badge.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The run stands at rest, its gate lowered, and nothing is lost yet.
styles.usage: Prose, a decision's text, a form's question. fg on panel.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: The agents you hold a grant on.
styles.usage: The line under a title that says what the page or pane is. dim.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Masthead links and the stage rail's names. dim, fg where current.

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Table cells, stream rows, a list's items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: A table head, a field's label, a pane's source line (then weight 400, dim), a note under a control (then faint).

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Every identifier, position, verb, state word, fingerprint, path and raw value. Rendered as it came, never prettified.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: The text of a mark: an absence pill, a status word, a backing badge, a query chip.

styles.name: stage-numeral
styles.usage: The stage's number in a stage mark, boxed, before the stage's name.

spacing.note: A 4px scale. The built stylesheet's rem values round onto it: .8rem 1.4rem masthead padding is space-3 space-5, 1.6rem main padding is space-6, .55rem .8rem cell padding is space-2 space-3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a stage numeral and its name; a pill's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Cell padding (vertical), gap between marks in a row, a control's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding (horizontal), a pane header's padding, gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A pane body's padding; the gutter between panes.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Masthead and stage rail horizontal padding; a diagram node's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The workspace's outer padding; space under a page title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between pane groups on a long page; the diagram's wire run between nodes.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Clearance around the agent's edge in the Declare diagram; a page's bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, a stage numeral's box, a diagram node.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: A pane, a table wrap, a dialog, the agent's edge in the diagram.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every mark: absence pill, status word, backing badge, query chip.

size.note: Fixed heights the grammar relies on.

tokens.name: masthead-h
tokens.usage: The masthead's height.

tokens.name: rail-h
tokens.usage: The stage rail's height under the masthead.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: A button, input or select; 36px where the action changes the agent (a verb, a turn).

tokens.name: control-h-verb
tokens.usage: A button that asks a verb or places a turn.

tokens.name: content-w
tokens.usage: The workspace's largest width, from the built listing main.
